text.en: You're the one who walked the pans clear. Then look here: our kiln-keeper burns by a rod, and the rod is gone — a poacher took it for a walking stick, of all the uses in the world.
text.id: Kau yang membersihkan petak itu. Lihat sini: penjaga tungku kami membakar dengan tongkat ukur, dan tongkatnya hilang — dibawa pemencol jadi tongkat jalan, dari semua kegunaan di dunia.

text.en: I watched them lean on it down by the burn ground, arguing over whose turn to carry coal. Take it back — and if they object, remind them whose fire they're stealing.
text.id: Kulihat mereka menyandarkannya di tanah pembakaran, bertengkar soal giliran mengangkut arang. Ambil kembali — dan kalau mereka keberatan, ingatkan api siapa yang mereka curi.

text.en: What's a burned stick worth to anyone?
I'll watch the ricks till you're back. Try the burn ground — they keep to where the coal is.
text.id: Kujaga tumpukan ini sampai kau kembali. Coba tanah pembakaran — mereka berkumpul di mana arangnya.

text.en: To a kiln-keeper? Every burn for a season. To anyone else, nothing — which is why they took it.
text.id: Bagi penjaga tungku? Semua bakaran satu musim. Bagi orang lain, tidak ada — itulah kenapa mereka mengambilnya.
